name: Hozumi Moa
source:
A member of the fortune club. Moa has no friends because other students consider her strange. When she knows Takuma predicts him a future surrounded by many girls and sex.

She's the female reincarnation of Michel de Nôtre-Dame (Nostradamus).
translation:
占卜部成员。由于其他学生觉得她很奇怪，莫亚没有朋友。当她为拓马占卜时，预言他将来会被许多女孩和性爱包围。

她是米歇尔·德·诺特达姆（诺查丹玛斯）的女性转世。
